title: SmartFarmer
description: Automatically replaces harvested crops with new ones when using a hoe. Supports wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, cocoa beans, and nether wart.
body:
Automatically replants crops when harvested with a hoe.
Just right-click mature crops while holding any hoe, and the crop will be harvested and instantly replanted.
Works with wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, cocoa beans, and nether wart.
Great for farms — no need to manually replant!
